notes.subject: Kristy call notes — final handwritten batch
notes.body: Kristy's sheet lists Vineyard UT Days, 801-226-4299, info@vineyardutah.gov, event manager Teresa 801-836-9733, and events@vineyardut.gov. Note says Teresa was very helpful and instructed Adventure Zone to send email; another July event is also noted. Preserve as a warm municipal contact.
